children: Table Trac declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.02 per share, payable December 11, 2026.
The Board declared a $0.02-per-share cash dividend on the company’s common stock.
Shareholders of record at the close of business on November 27, 2026, will receive the dividend.
The Board said the dividend reflects confidence in the company’s financial strength and long-term strategy.
CEO Randy Gilbert cited recurring revenue as a foundation for growth, investment, and returning value to shareholders.
